articles.title: A Record Older Than Him: Josh Kerr Smashes 27-Year-Old Mile Mark!
articles.summary: British runner Josh Kerr just broke a world record that was set when he was a baby! He ran a mile in 3 minutes and 42.66 seconds, beating the old record by almost half a second. The crowd of 60,000 in London went wild.

articles.title: Soccer, Nails, and Dreams: The Women of the World Cup
articles.summary: At the 2026 World Cup, reporter Jasmine Garsd found a hidden story: women showing their love for soccer through amazing nail art. She also met a coach who was once told soccer wasn't for girls—and now helps young Muslim players chase their dreams.

articles.title: Meet the UK's New Prime Minister: Andy Burnham, the Dad Dancer!
articles.summary: Andy Burnham is about to become the UK's new prime minister. He's known as a friendly guy who loves soccer, poetry, and dancing to New Order. But some people wonder: is he tough enough for the job?
